text:
emma: Heads up: onboarding sample-rerank failed in CI. Root cause looks like mixed embedding shapes + field-name flip during batching.

ravi: Paste the sanitized response and which SDKs/aliases please.

emma: Node sample (node-sdk@0.14) defaulted to alias open-embed-compact -> response: {"data":[{"id":"u1","vector":[/* 768 floats */]}]}
Python sample (py-sdk@0.15) used open-embed-wide -> response: {"data":[{"id":"u1","embedding":[/* 1536 floats */]}]}
CI error: rerank/batcher.py:45 AssertionError expected (3,1536) got (3,768)

zoe: Two separate DX issues: 1) SDK alias defaults diverged; 2) the aggregator relies on arrival-index and has no strong request id tagging, so retries (from token refresh) can interleave responses and we end up merging vectors with different keys.

marc: Also saw field-name drift historically: older SDKs used `vector` then later `embedding`. If the batcher picks the first-arrived key we get inconsistent stacks.

ci-bot: CI: samples/rerank-onboard #2043 failed  see logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/2043 (sanitized).

ravi: Quick mitigation: in the shared embed helper add a strict normalizer: prefer `embedding`, fall back `vector`/`vec`; canonicalize to `embedding`. Also add batch-id-tagging: server should echo an x-batch-id and SDKs should forward an x-idempotency-key so aggregator can reorder by request id, not arrival.

emma: I pushed a tiny samples change that pads/trims vectors and normalizes keys so demos don't fail. PR: https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/1505 (wip).

infra-bot: Created infra ticket infra/512: ensure token-refresh retry preserves x-idempotency-key and x-request-id headers.

zoe: Long-term plan: 1) SDK parity CI: run node/python/rust clients against each embed alias and assert (field_name == 'embedding') && (dim == catalog[alias]); 2) SDKs set x-idempotency-key on all retry attempts; 3) server returns canonical key `embedding` for all aliases (shim older aliases if needed); 4) sample-apps include a quick onboarding check snippet: `EXPECTED = catalog[alias]
if len(emb) != EXPECTED: raise RuntimeError(...)`.

marc: I'll take the idempotency header enforcement and a small change to the aggregator to prefer request-id ordering if present. @ravi can you add the parity CI job?

ravi: Yep, will add a job that calls each alias once in both SDKs and compares reported dims/keys; auto-create an issue if any mismatch.

emma: For now the normalize + pad_or_trim in samples is enough to unblock demos. Will attach sanitized failing payload to the PR so infra/SDK folks have repro. :thumbsup: 

zoe: Reminder for docs: add a short troubleshooting bullet under Embeddings Onboarding about alias sizes, field-name differences, and how to run the parity check script.

emma: Thanks all — small DX fixes but avoids huge confusion for new users.
